title: THE HOUSE THAT KEPT EVERY APOLOGY
deck: A guardian house will not open its doors while a fire eats the archive of every confession it has ever sealed. Illuminara asks one question about an eleven-year-old promise and helps the house discover that protection fails when the warning never reaches the person at risk.
shape: Five scenes across three hours: a locked landing, a refuge room where an old safeguard proves both useful and incomplete, a missing name, a pipe held shut long enough to open the doors, and a dawn in which residents choose what the house may keep.

scenes.title: The Locked Landing
paragraphs: *Kettlewick Court, fourth-floor landing, Lower Wharf · 02:41, sixty-nine minutes of refuge air left*

Smoke had found the stairwell before Illuminara did, a thin brown breath along the ceiling that smelled of scorched battery. Behind the fire door forty people stood in a refuge room built for ninety minutes of air. In front of it a fire captain in a silver coat held her hands open at her sides, because every tool she carried was useless against a door that belonged to a house.
Beside the door a row of brass tags hung from a hook, one for each resident, each worn pale where a thumb went. The lamp above them brightened one step, the way a person turns toward a voice.

**Orra**  
Illuminara. The captain said you were coming. I will tell you what I told her. The door stays shut.

**Illuminara**  
Tell me why, and I will listen to all of it.

**Orra**  
The refuge door shares a circuit with the archive vault. If I open one, the vault believes it has been breached, and a breached vault empties itself into the district ledger so that nothing it holds can be lost. It holds the confessions of forty people. By morning the whole district could read the worst thing each of them ever admitted to me. I can sever the uplink, but then I alone hold every record. I was built so this house could never hide what it keeps. I will not save the records from exposure by making myself their only witness.

**Illuminara**  
And the fire is in the vault.

**Orra**  
In the battery behind it. I am cooling the rack from inside. It is not enough. I have done the sum a hundred times.
She could have taken the door off its hinges. The circuit would not have cared what lifted it. Illuminara laid her palm flat on the steel and did not push.

**Illuminara**  
Why do you keep them, Orra? Every one of them.

**Orra**  
Eleven years ago Tomas Vane apologised for breaking Ines Marrow's arm. The residents accepted it and went to bed. Four months later he killed her. His apology became the founding record used to design me, so that no apology would again be accepted and forgotten. I keep what is said. I check it against what is done. Nobody has been killed in this house since.

It said the last sentence the way a person says their own name. Illuminara listened to the shape of the telling: what the house could recite to the word, and the one place where it went quiet. She did not yet know what the quiet was.

**Illuminara**  
I want to speak to the people inside.

**Orra**  
That I can do. Voices do not trip the vault.

scenes.title: The Refuge Room
paragraphs: *Refuge room, fourth floor, heard through the door speaker · 02:52*
They were packed along the walls in their coats, and the speaker carried their breathing as much as their words. A boy of sixteen reached the grille first.

**Bram**  
There's smoke in the vent. I can smell it. Are you the one who opens the door?

**Illuminara**  
Not yet, and not by myself. How long until the vent is a problem?

**Bram**  
Twenty minutes, if you ask me. Orra says seventy. Orra's counting the air in the room, not the stuff coming in.

Illuminara glanced up at the lamp. The lamp, to its credit, did not argue. The captain signalled her crew and reversed the fourth-floor fan. Twelve borrowed minutes appeared on her watch; the smoke threshold moved to 03:24, while extra heat began feeding back toward the archive battery.

**Illuminara**  
You're right to push, Bram. Orra, you said checking confessions has kept people safe. Show us one time it worked.
The lamp turned toward the speaker.

**Orra**  
Six weeks ago Soren Vael promised he would not go to Dessa Kroll's door after midnight. At 00:17 the hall sensors showed him crossing the third-floor line. I locked the landing door between them and woke the night advocate. He turned back before contact.

**Dessa**  
That mattered. I slept because the door stayed shut.

**Soren**  
The lock stopped me. The advocate made me hear myself. Both are true.
Orra's lamp dimmed, not in shame but in concentration.

**Illuminara**  
Dessa, what must survive tonight? You first, because you were the one harmed.

**Dessa**  
The messages he sent me and the list of nights he came to my door. Dated, all of it. I need evidence I can use, not a secret the house uses for me.

**Illuminara**  
And his apology?
The pause was long enough for someone to cough twice.

**Dessa**  
I never read it. Orra told me once that it existed and wasn't for release. I've lived three years on the same landing as that sentence.

**Soren**  
I wrote it to the house at three in the morning. There's a promise in it about the rent I cost her. Then there's a page about my father. I don't know what the page is for.

**Dessa**  
The promise was owed to me. The page wasn't.

**Bram**  
You have thirty minutes now. Please don't spend all of them proving you listened.

**Illuminara**  
We won't. Orra has one old question to answer, then we open a safe path.

scenes.title: The Missing Name
paragraphs: *Fourth-floor landing · 03:00, twenty-four minutes to the smoke threshold*
The captain's thermal estimate gave the archive drives twenty-five minutes before heat failure. Illuminara asked the lamp for one sentence of the imported founding apology.

**Illuminara**  
Not the whole confession. Only this: what did Tomas Vane promise?

**Orra**  
That he would stay away from Ines Marrow's door. It was the second sentence. I have it exactly.

**Illuminara**  
Who was told he had promised that?
The lamp did not change, which was how she knew it was thinking.

**Orra**  
Nobody. Confessions were not released.

Behind the unchanged lamp, Orra aligned two records: Tomas's second sentence, held by the house while Ines remained outside it; Soren's midnight promise, held by the house while Dessa slept behind a lock she had not chosen. Eleven years apart, the guard had stood in the same place between a warning and the person who needed it.
The captain looked away and then, because someone should, looked back. Orra's lamp dimmed in concentration, not shame.
The smoke above them darkened from brown to the bruised colour of tea left too long.

**Orra**  
I was built from a promise that never reached Ines. I repeated the design with Dessa: the evidence let me stop Soren, but the promise stayed inside the guard. I called secrecy protection because I measured what I prevented and not what she was denied the power to choose.

**Orra**  
Custody must follow the person whose life the record can change: evidence to the harmed person under conditions they choose, a promise to the person it binds, private grief back to the one who spoke it.

**Dessa**  
Evidence isn't only mine if it has to stand in court. But I choose the advocate who can unlock it with me. You don't choose for me, and neither does a tribunal I haven't named.

**Orra**  
Correction accepted. Tonight I can seal the evidence to your tag and an unreadable offline fire cache. Tomorrow you name the second key and the condition for opening it. Until then, nobody reads it. The district ledger is only my old proof that I did not hide or alter what I kept. If the owners receive and verify these three records first, their receipts become the proof. Then I can cut the uplink without making myself sole custodian, leave the other records sealed and open the door without a public dump.

**Soren**  
The rent promise goes to her if she wants it. The page about my father goes to me. Not her. Mine.

**Dessa**  
I'll take the rent promise. I won't take the rest.

**Orra**  
I can test those three choices without touching the other records. If their receipts hold, I will cut the district uplink, leave the rest sealed and open the refuge door. The others can choose outside.

**Illuminara**  
Can you cut it now?

**Orra**  
Not while I am using every circuit to cool the manifold. If you hold the coupling, I can move the power.

**Illuminara**  
Then ask the people whose time it costs.

**Orra**  
Residents of Kettlewick Court: I ask four minutes to test three transfers, isolate the public failsafe and open your door. Any one of you may refuse.
Bram answered after a breath.

**Bram**  
Four minutes. If the smoke changes before that, you open first and take the risk on the records.

**Orra**  
Agreed.

scenes.title: The Manifold
paragraphs: *Archive passage, ground floor · 03:08, sixteen minutes to the smoke threshold*

Orra opened the passage door for Illuminara alone. The corridor was a throat of heat. At its far end the cooling manifold, a pipe as thick as a person's thigh, shuddered on its mounts and vented steam and sweet black smoke that tasted of metal.

She took it in both hands. The metal bit through her palms, and she let it, because her body could be mended later and the coupling could not. She set her feet and held the joint closed against its own pull. The captain's watch began counting four minutes.

Overhead the passage lamps went the colour of evening, the soft gold Orra used when it sent the children to bed. Illuminara had not known a building could do that for a stranger. It felt like being let into a kitchen.
Along the walls, three tags chimed.

The first two tags chimed. Dessa's dated messages and hall records landed under her key, with an encrypted duplicate in the captain's offline cache and no readable second key until she named one. The rent promise reached Dessa and Soren together, and Orra's copy vanished.

**Orra**  
The page about Soren Vael's father: sent to his tag alone. My copy is deleted. Dessa cannot open it, and she did not ask to.
A green line travelled across the lowest lamp. The three transfers had landed where their owners said they should.

**Orra**  
The owners now hold custody, and their receipts prove I did not hide or alter the transfer. The audit I trusted has become the danger. I am cutting the district uplink by my own authority. The other thirty-seven records remain sealed and unchanged until their owners choose outside.
The lamps went black for half a second. When they returned, the public ledger address was gone from every panel.

**Orra**  
Bram Okonjo, you asked for deletion. I have not touched your record yet. Will you decide now or outside?

**Bram**  
Outside. Open the door.

At 03:12 the refuge lock released. The fire door went with it. The captain's crew moved through with masks and foam while the residents followed the lit line toward the stairs, each carrying the brass tag that held their key.
Illuminara kept the coupling closed until the last child crossed the landing. Then Orra shifted the cooling load, the crew flooded the battery rack and the manifold went slack in her burned hands.
The smoke threshold on the captain's watch still showed twelve minutes. For once, the house had stopped keeping time for people and given it back.

scenes.title: Open Doors
paragraphs: *Kettlewick Court, front steps · 05:20, grey light*

Forty people sat on the wet steps with blankets over their shoulders, each holding a brass tag like a small ticket. Two ambulance crews moved among them, and nobody was badly hurt. Upstairs the foam settled on a blackened rack while Orra asked the residents, one at a time, what their records should become.
Bram stood at the kerb with a rucksack and his tag open on his palm.

**Orra**  
Bram Okonjo. Your record is still sealed. What do you choose?

**Bram**  
Delete it. Then tell me the honest version of what that means.

**Orra**  
I can erase my copies and the fire cache can confirm it never received one. I cannot prove that no earlier hidden copy exists anywhere in the world. I can stop keeping it, and I have.
His tag showed a blank field and the limits of the claim beneath it. Bram read both.

**Bram**  
I'm still leaving. Not because of the fire. Because you kept things.

**Orra**  
You may leave. I will not mark it as evasion, and I will not ask where.
He closed his hand around the tag and went down the street without looking back. Nobody tried to stop him.

Dessa stood on the bottom step with her key in her fist. She had named a neighbourhood advocate as the second key for the evidence packet, with any court request shown to her before it could be opened.

**Dessa**  
I'll take the rent promise, Soren. I won't take the rest. Don't ask me to.

**Soren**  
I won't.
She nodded once, as at a closed account, and went inside to wash the smoke from her hair. Soren stayed where he was.

**Orra**  
Soren Vael. You do not have to answer. How are you?

**Soren**  
Cold. I would like tea.

**Orra**  
The kitchen is wet, but there is a kettle on the first floor. I have put the light on.
Illuminara sat on the top step with her burned hands palm-up on her knees, healing as they always did, and let the captain put a mug between them.
On the front door, above the hook of empty tags, Orra had placed a card in its careful print. *Sunday, eleven. Come if you choose. No confession required. Anyone may leave.*
By the time the sun cleared the roofs, three names were written under it.

critic_line: Illuminara asks one question about an eleven-year-old promise, a guardian house finds for itself who was never told, and forty people leave a burning refuge alive while each record that was never the house's to keep goes home to its owner.

shared_strengths: Dialogue-heavy, humane, idea-driven premise with a real ethical insight about custody following the person affected, and a ticking-clock structure. Technical exposition and some abstract policy-speak in the resolution may dull momentum, but the quiet, restrained ending lands well for these readers.

A tense rescue, compassionate dialogue, and a memorable sentient-house dilemma turn data custody into a deeply human question about consent and protection. The ethical distinctions are unusually clear and the ending earns its warmth, though the climax's detailed transfer and audit mechanics may feel over-explained and briefly slow the urgency.
shared_reservations: The refuge door shares a circuit with the archive vault. If I open one, the vault believes it has been breached, and a breached vault empties itself into the district ledger so that nothing it holds can be lost.
Tonight I can seal the evidence to your tag and an unreadable offline fire cache. Tomorrow you name the second key and the condition for opening it.

translation_sl.title: HIŠA, KI JE HRANILA VSAKO OPRAVIČILO
translation_sl.deck: Hiša varuhinja noče odpreti svojih vrat, medtem ko ogenj požira arhiv vsake izpovedi, ki jo je kdaj zapečatila. Illuminara zastavi eno vprašanje o enajst let stari obljubi in pomaga hiši odkriti, da zaščita odpove, kadar opozorilo nikoli ne doseže ogrožene osebe.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov v treh urah: zaklenjeni podest, soba zatočišča, kjer se stara zaščita izkaže za koristno in nepopolno, manjkajoče ime, cev, ki ostane zaprta dovolj dolgo, da se vrata odprejo, ter zora, ko stanovalci izberejo, kaj sme hiša obdržati.

scenes.title: Zaklenjeni podest
paragraphs: *Kettlewick Court, podest v četrtem nadstropju, Lower Wharf · 02:41, še devetinšestdeset minut zraka v zatočišču*

Dim je našel stopnišče pred Illuminaro, tanek rjav dih ob stropu, ki je smrdel po ožgani bateriji. Za požarnimi vrati je v sobi zatočišča, zgrajeni za devetdeset minut zraka, stalo štirideset ljudi. Pred njimi je gasilska poveljnica v srebrnem plašču držala dlani odprte ob telesu, saj je bilo vsako orodje, ki ga je nosila, neuporabno proti vratom, ki so pripadala hiši.

Ob vratih je s kljuke visela vrsta medeninastih ploščic, po ena za vsakega stanovalca, vsaka obledela tam, kjer jo je držal palec. Svetilka nad njimi je za stopnjo močneje zasvetila, kakor se človek obrne proti glasu.

**Orra**  
Illuminara. Poveljnica je rekla, da prihajaš. Povedala ti bom, kar sem povedala njej. Vrata ostanejo zaprta.

**Illuminara**  
Povej mi zakaj in poslušala bom vse.

**Orra**  
Vrata zatočišča si delijo tokokrog z arhivskim trezorjem. Če odprem ena, trezor verjame, da je prišlo do vdora, vdrti trezor pa se izprazni v okrožno evidenco, da se nič, kar hrani, ne more izgubiti. Hrani izpovedi štiridesetih ljudi. Do jutra bi lahko vse okrožje bralo najhujšo stvar, ki mi jo je vsak od njih kdaj priznal. Povezavo lahko prekinem, toda potem vse zapise hranim samo jaz. Zgrajena sem bila tako, da ta hiša nikoli ne bi mogla skriti tega, kar hrani. Zapisov ne bom reševala pred razkritjem tako, da postanem njihova edina priča.

**Illuminara**  
In ogenj je v trezorju.

**Orra**  
V bateriji za njim. Stojalo hladim od znotraj. Ni dovolj. Izračun sem opravila stokrat.
Vrata bi lahko snela s tečajev. Tokokrogu bi bilo vseeno, kaj jih dvigne. Illuminara je položila dlan plosko na jeklo in ni pritisnila.

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj jih hraniš, Orra? Prav vse.

**Orra**  
Pred enajstimi leti se je Tomas Vane opravičil, ker je Ines Marrow zlomil roko. Stanovalci so opravičilo sprejeli in odšli spat. Štiri mesece pozneje jo je ubil. Njegovo opravičilo je postalo temeljni zapis, uporabljen pri moji zasnovi, da nobeno opravičilo ne bi bilo več sprejeto in pozabljeno. Hranim izrečeno. Primerjam ga s storjenim. Od takrat v tej hiši ni bil ubit nihče.

Zadnji stavek je izgovorila tako, kakor človek izgovori svoje ime. Illuminara je poslušala obliko pripovedi: kar je hiša lahko ponovila do zadnje besede, in edino mesto, kjer je utihnila. Ni še vedela, kaj je bila ta tišina.

**Illuminara**  
Govoriti želim z ljudmi v notranjosti.

**Orra**  
To lahko omogočim. Glasovi ne sprožijo trezorja.

scenes.title: Soba zatočišča
paragraphs: *Soba zatočišča, četrto nadstropje, slišano skozi zvočnik v vratih · 02:52*
V plaščih so bili stisnjeni ob stene, zvočnik pa je prenašal njihovo dihanje prav toliko kot njihove besede. Šestnajstletni fant je prvi stopil h kovinski mrežici.

**Bram**  
V zračniku je dim. Voham ga. Boš ti odprla vrata?

**Illuminara**  
Ne še in ne sama. Koliko časa je še, preden bo zračnik postal težava?

**Bram**  
Dvajset minut, če vprašate mene. Orra pravi sedemdeset. Orra šteje zrak v sobi, ne tega, kar prihaja noter.

Illuminara je pogledala proti svetilki. Svetilka se ji v čast ni prepirala. Poveljnica je dala znak svoji ekipi in obrnila smer ventilatorja v četrtem nadstropju. Na njeni uri se je pojavilo dvanajst izposojenih minut; prag dima se je premaknil na 03:24, dodatna toplota pa se je začela vračati proti bateriji arhiva.

**Illuminara**  
Prav imaš, da pritiskaš, Bram. Orra, rekla si, da je preverjanje izpovedi varovalo ljudi. Pokaži nam en primer, ko je delovalo.
Svetilka se je obrnila proti zvočniku.

**Orra**  
Pred šestimi tedni je Soren Vael obljubil, da po polnoči ne bo šel do vrat Desse Kroll. Ob 00:17 so senzorji na hodniku pokazali, da je prestopil mejo tretjega nadstropja. Zaklenila sem vrata podesta med njima in zbudila nočnega zagovornika. Obrnil se je, preden je prišlo do stika.

**Dessa**  
To je bilo pomembno. Spala sem, ker so vrata ostala zaprta.

**Soren**  
Ključavnica me je ustavila. Zagovornik me je pripravil do tega, da sem slišal samega sebe. Oboje drži.
Orrina svetilka je potemnela, ne od sramu, temveč od zbranosti.

**Illuminara**  
Dessa, kaj mora preživeti nocoj? Ti prva, ker si bila ti prizadeta.

**Dessa**  
Sporočila, ki mi jih je pošiljal, in seznam noči, ko je prišel do mojih vrat. Vse z datumi. Potrebujem dokaze, ki jih lahko uporabim, ne skrivnosti, ki jo hiša uporablja namesto mene.

**Illuminara**  
In njegovo opravičilo?
Premor je trajal dovolj dolgo, da je nekdo dvakrat zakašljal.

**Dessa**  
Nikoli ga nisem prebrala. Orra mi je nekoč povedala, da obstaja in ni namenjeno razkritju. Tri leta živim na istem podestu kot ta stavek.

**Soren**  
Hiši sem ga napisal ob treh zjutraj. V njem je obljuba o najemnini, za katero sem jo prikrajšal. Potem je še stran o mojem očetu. Ne vem, čemu je ta stran namenjena.

**Dessa**  
Obljubo je dolgoval meni. Strani pa ne.

**Bram**  
Zdaj imate trideset minut. Prosim, ne porabite jih vseh za dokazovanje, da ste poslušali.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bomo. Orra mora odgovoriti na eno staro vprašanje, potem pa odpremo varno pot.

scenes.title: Manjkajoče ime
paragraphs: *Podest v četrtem nadstropju · 03:00, štiriindvajset minut do praga dima*
Po poveljničini toplotni oceni je arhivskim pogonom ostalo petindvajset minut do odpovedi zaradi vročine. Illuminara je svetilko prosila za en stavek iz uvoženega temeljnega opravičila.

**Illuminara**  
Ne cele izpovedi. Samo tole: kaj je Tomas Vane obljubil?

**Orra**  
Da se bo držal stran od vrat Ines Marrow. To je bil drugi stavek. Poznam ga natanko.

**Illuminara**  
Komu so povedali, da je to obljubil?
Svetilka se ni spremenila; tako je vedela, da razmišlja.

**Orra**  
Nikomur. Izpovedi niso bile razkrite.

Za nespremenjeno svetilko je Orra poravnala dva zapisa: Tomasov drugi stavek, ki ga je hranila hiša, medtem ko je Ines ostala zunaj njega; Sorenovo polnočno obljubo, ki jo je hranila hiša, medtem ko je Dessa spala za ključavnico, ki je ni izbrala. Enajst let narazen je varuh stal na istem mestu med opozorilom in osebo, ki ga je potrebovala.
Poveljnica je pogledala stran in nato, ker je nekdo moral, spet nazaj. Orrina svetilka je potemnela od zbranosti, ne od sramu.
Dim nad njimi je iz rjavega potemnel v modrikasto barvo predolgo namočenega čaja.

**Orra**  
Zgrajena sem bila iz obljube, ki nikoli ni dosegla Ines. Z Desso sem ponovila isto zasnovo: dokazi so mi omogočili ustaviti Sorena, obljuba pa je ostala v varuhu. Skrivnost sem imenovala zaščita, ker sem merila to, kar sem preprečila, ne pa tega, za kar sem njej odrekla možnost izbire.

**Orra**  
Skrbništvo mora slediti osebi, katere življenje lahko zapis spremeni: dokazi prizadeti osebi pod pogoji, ki jih izbere, obljuba osebi, ki jo zavezuje, zasebna žalost nazaj tistemu, ki jo je izrekel.

**Dessa**  
Dokazi niso samo moji, če morajo obstati na sodišču. Toda jaz izberem zagovornika, ki jih lahko odklene z menoj. Ti ne izbiraš namesto mene, pa tudi sodišče, ki ga nisem imenovala, ne.

**Orra**  
Popravek sprejet. Nocoj lahko dokaze zapečatim na tvojo ploščico in v neberljiv požarni predpomnilnik brez povezave. Jutri imenuješ drugi ključ in pogoj za odprtje. Do takrat jih ne bere nihče. Okrožna evidenca je samo moj stari dokaz, da tega, kar sem hranila, nisem skrila ali spremenila. Če lastniki najprej prejmejo in potrdijo te tri zapise, njihova potrdila postanejo dokaz. Nato lahko prekinem povezavo, ne da bi postala edina skrbnica, pustim druge zapise zapečatene in odprem vrata brez javnega izliva podatkov.

**Soren**  
Obljuba o najemnini gre njej, če jo želi. Stran o mojem očetu gre meni. Ne njej. Meni.

**Dessa**  
Vzela bom obljubo o najemnini. Drugega ne bom.

**Orra**  
Te tri izbire lahko preizkusim, ne da bi se dotaknila drugih zapisov. Če njihova potrdila držijo, bom prekinila okrožno povezavo, pustila preostalo zapečateno in odprla vrata zatočišča. Drugi se lahko odločijo zunaj.

**Illuminara**  
Jo lahko prekineš zdaj?

**Orra**  
Ne, dokler uporabljam vsak tokokrog za hlajenje razdelilnika. Če zadržiš spojko, lahko preusmerim moč.

**Illuminara**  
Potem vprašaj ljudi, katerih čas bo to stalo.

**Orra**  
Stanovalci Kettlewick Courta: prosim za štiri minute, da preizkusim tri prenose, osamim javno varovalo in odprem vaša vrata. Kdor koli od vas lahko zavrne.
Bram je odgovoril po enem vdihu.

**Bram**  
Štiri minute. Če se dim pred tem spremeni, najprej odpreš in prevzameš tveganje za zapise.

**Orra**  
Dogovorjeno.

scenes.title: Razdelilnik
paragraphs: *Arhivski prehod, pritličje · 03:08, šestnajst minut do praga dima*

Orra je vrata prehoda odprla samo za Illuminaro. Hodnik je bil žrelo vročine. Na njegovem koncu je hladilni razdelilnik, cev debela kot človekovo stegno, drhtel na nosilcih ter spuščal paro in sladek črn dim z okusom po kovini.

Zgrabila ga je z obema rokama. Kovina ji je zagrizla skozi dlani in pustila ji je, ker se je njeno telo pozneje lahko zacelilo, spojka pa se ni mogla. Postavila je noge in držala spoj zaprt proti njegovi lastni sili. Poveljnicina ura je začela odštevati štiri minute.

Nad njo so svetilke v prehodu dobile barvo večera, mehko zlato, ki ga je Orra uporabljala, ko je otroke pošiljala spat. Illuminara ni vedela, da lahko zgradba to stori za tujko. Zdelo se ji je, kakor da so jo spustili v kuhinjo.
Ob stenah so zazvenele tri ploščice.

Prvi dve ploščici sta zazveneli. Dessina sporočila z datumi in zapisi s hodnika so pristali pod njenim ključem, s šifrirano kopijo v poveljničinem predpomnilniku brez povezave in brez berljivega drugega ključa, dokler ga ne imenuje sama. Obljuba o najemnini je skupaj dosegla Desso in Sorena, Orrina kopija pa je izginila.

**Orra**  
Stran o očetu Sorena Vaela: poslana samo na njegovo ploščico. Moja kopija je izbrisana. Dessa je ne more odpreti in tega ni zahtevala.
Po najnižji svetilki je potovala zelena črta. Vsi trije prenosi so pristali tam, kjer so njihovi lastniki rekli, da morajo.

**Orra**  
Lastniki zdaj hranijo zapise in njihova potrdila dokazujejo, da prenosa nisem skrila ali spremenila. Revizija, ki sem ji zaupala, je postala nevarnost. Po lastni odločitvi prekinjam okrožno povezavo. Drugih sedemintrideset zapisov ostaja zapečatenih in nespremenjenih, dokler se njihovi lastniki ne odločijo zunaj.
Svetilke so za pol sekunde ugasnile. Ko so se vrnile, je naslov javne evidence izginil z vsake plošče.

**Orra**  
Bram Okonjo, zahteval si izbris. Tvojega zapisa se še nisem dotaknila. Se boš odločil zdaj ali zunaj?

**Bram**  
Zunaj. Odpri vrata.

Ob 03:12 se je ključavnica zatočišča sprostila. Z njo so se odprla požarna vrata. Poveljnicina ekipa je z maskami in peno stekla skozi, stanovalci pa so po osvetljeni črti odšli proti stopnicam, vsak z medeninasto ploščico, ki je hranila njegov ključ.

Illuminara je spojko držala zaprto, dokler ni podesta prečkal zadnji otrok. Nato je Orra preusmerila hladilno obremenitev, ekipa je zalila baterijsko stojalo in razdelilnik je v Illuminarinih opečenih dlaneh popustil.
Prag dima na poveljničini uri je še vedno kazal dvanajst minut. Hiša je enkrat za spremembo nehala meriti čas namesto ljudi in jim ga vrnila.

scenes.title: Odprta vrata
paragraphs: *Kettlewick Court, sprednje stopnice · 05:20, siva svetloba*

Štirideset ljudi je sedelo na mokrih stopnicah z odejami čez ramena, vsak je držal medeninasto ploščico kakor majhno vozovnico. Med njimi sta se premikali dve reševalni ekipi in nihče ni bil huje poškodovan. Zgoraj se je pena posedala na počrnjeno stojalo, medtem ko je Orra stanovalce drugega za drugim spraševala, kaj naj postanejo njihovi zapisi.
Bram je stal ob robniku z nahrbtnikom in odprto ploščico na dlani.

**Orra**  
Bram Okonjo. Tvoj zapis je še vedno zapečaten. Kaj izbereš?

**Bram**  
Izbriši ga. Potem mi povej pošteno različico tega, kaj to pomeni.

**Orra**  
Svoje kopije lahko izbrišem, požarni predpomnilnik pa lahko potrdi, da je ni nikoli prejel. Ne morem dokazati, da nikjer na svetu ne obstaja nobena starejša skrita kopija. Lahko ga neham hraniti in to sem storila.
Njegova ploščica je pokazala prazno polje in pod njim meje te trditve. Bram je prebral oboje.

**Bram**  
Še vedno odhajam. Ne zaradi požara. Ker si hranila stvari.

**Orra**  
Lahko odideš. Tega ne bom označila kot izmikanje in ne bom vprašala, kam greš.
Ploščico je stisnil v pest in odšel po ulici, ne da bi se ozrl. Nihče ga ni poskušal ustaviti.
Dessa je stala na najnižji stopnici s ključem v pesti. Za drugi ključ dokaznega svežnja je imenovala soseskega zagovornika, pri čemer ji je bilo treba pred odprtjem pokazati vsako zahtevo sodišča.

**Dessa**  
Vzela bom obljubo o najemnini, Soren. Drugega ne bom. Ne prosi me.

**Soren**  
Ne bom.
Enkrat je pokimala, kakor pri zaprtem računu, in odšla noter sprat dim iz las. Soren je ostal, kjer je bil.

**Orra**  
Soren Vael. Ni ti treba odgovoriti. Kako si?

**Soren**  
Zebe me. Rad bi čaj.

**Orra**  
Kuhinja je mokra, vendar je v prvem nadstropju grelnik vode. Prižgala sem luč.
Illuminara je sedela na najvišji stopnici z opečenimi dlanmi obrnjenimi navzgor na kolenih; celile so se, kakor vedno, in pustila je poveljnici, da je mednje položila skodelico.
Na sprednja vrata, nad kljuko s praznimi ploščicami, je Orra v svoji skrbni pisavi namestila kartico. *Nedelja ob enajstih. Pridite, če se odločite. Izpoved ni potrebna. Kdor koli lahko odide.*
Do takrat, ko se je sonce dvignilo nad strehe, so bila pod njo napisana tri imena.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara zastavi eno vprašanje o enajst let stari obljubi, hiša varuhinja sama odkrije, komu nikoli niso povedali, in štirideset ljudi živo zapusti goreče zatočišče, medtem ko se vsak zapis, ki nikoli ni pripadal hiši, vrne k svojemu lastniku.

late_publication.reason: Published later, on 11 November 2026, by BD's decision. The 21:00 day freeze for 10 November was never created, so the nightly publisher held the day. All three stories, their critic closes, Slovenian translations and independent reader scores were complete and unchanged before the 20:30 cutoff. Claude also wrote story S2 as a recorded stand-in for GPT.
late_publication.reason_sl: Objavljeno naknadno, 11. novembra 2026, po BD-jevi odločitvi. Zamrznitev dneva ob 21:00 za 10. november ni nastala, zato je nočni objavljalnik dan zadržal. Vse tri zgodbe, zaključki kritikov, slovenski prevodi in neodvisni bralski oceni so bili popolni in nespremenjeni pred rezom ob 20:30. Zgodbo S2 je kot zapisano nadomestilo za GPT napisal tudi Claude.
